description: Norkyst - Gjennomsnittlig strømstyrke og retning is a dataset listed in National Data Catalog of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Havforskningsinstituttet. Datasettet stammer fra 10 års midlede verdier (2013-2022) av strømstyrke og retning i hhv overflaten, i vannmassene (intervaller for 5m, 15m, 30m, 50m, 100m, 150m, 200m og 250m), samt ved havbunnen. Avstanden fra havbunn går med gjeldende modelloppsett fra noen cm på grunt vann og opp til 1,5m når totaldybden er 100m eller mer. Coverage: Havforskningsinstituttet. The publisher named on the listing is Havforskningsinstituttet. Its keywords include ROMS, NorKyst-800, National, Natur, 10 års midlede verdier, havstrøm. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, SHP. The listing shows 2024-04-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-norge-no.
